english.name: The Great Escape
english.description: Ensure your colony's legacy by fulfilling the requirements of the Escape Imperative.

schinese.name: 大逃亡
schinese.description: 完成「逃逸令」要求，确保殖民地的传承。

english.name: Home Sweet Home
english.description: Establish your permanent home by fulfilling the requirements of the Colonize Imperative.

schinese.name: 甜蜜的家
schinese.description: 完成「殖民令」要求，建立你的永久家园。

english.name: Locavore
english.description: Have Duplicants consume 400,000kcal of food without planting any seeds in Planter Boxes, Farm Tiles, or Hydroponic Farms.

schinese.name: 本地膳食
schinese.description: 让复制人消耗400,000千卡食物，且不得在种植箱、农地砖或水耕农场中种植任何种子。

english.name: Carnivore
english.description: Have Duplicants eat 400,000kcal of critter meat before the 100th cycle.

schinese.name: 肉食者
schinese.description: 在第100周期之前让复制人食用400,000千卡的小动物肉。

english.name: Some Reservations
english.description: Improve Duplicant Morale by designating 4 areas as Nature Reserves.

schinese.name: 保留区
schinese.description: 指定4个区域为自然保护区，提升复制人士气。

english.name: No Place Like Clone
english.description: Have at least 20 living Duplicants living in the colony at one time.

schinese.name: 克隆之家
schinese.description: 同时拥有至少20名存活的复制人。

english.name: Turn of the Century
english.description: Reach cycle 100 with at least one living Duplicant.

schinese.name: 世纪之交
schinese.description: 到达第100周期，且至少有一名存活的复制人。

english.name: Moovin' On Up
english.description: Find and tame a Gassy Moo.

schinese.name: 更上一层楼
schinese.description: 发现并驯服一只释气牛。

english.name: Not 0K, But Pretty Cool
english.description: Reduce the temperature of a building to 6 Kelvin.

schinese.name: 不到绝对零度，但够凉了
schinese.description: 将一栋建筑物的温度降至6开尔文。

english.name: Super Sustainable
english.description: Generate 240,000kJ of power without using coal, methane, petrol or wood generators.

schinese.name: 超级可持续
schinese.description: 在不使用燃煤、甲烷、石油或木质发电机的情况下产生240,000千焦电力。

english.name: Outdoor Renovations
english.description: Construct a building outside the initial starting biome.

schinese.name: 户外改造
schinese.description: 在初始生态区之外建造一栋建筑物。

english.name: Totally Tubular
english.description: Have Duplicants travel 10,000m by Transit Tube.

schinese.name: 管道达人
schinese.description: 让复制人通过运输管行进10,000米。

english.name: Space Race
english.description: Launch your first rocket into space.

schinese.name: 太空竞赛
schinese.description: 发射你的第一枚火箭进入太空。

english.name: And Nowhere to Go
english.description: Have 8 Duplicants wear non-default clothing simultaneously.

schinese.name: 无处可去
schinese.description: 让8名复制人同时穿着非默认服装。

english.name: Get a Room
english.description: Build at least one of each of the following rooms in a single colony: A Nature Reserve, a Hospital, a Recreation Room, a Great Hall, a Bedroom, a Washroom, a Greenhouse and a Stable.

schinese.name: 弄个房间
schinese.description: 在单个殖民地中至少建造以下每种房间各一：自然保护区、医院、娱乐室、豪华大厅、卧室、卫生间、温室和畜舍。

english.name: One Year, to be Exact
english.description: Reach cycle 365.25 with a single colony.

schinese.name: 确切地说，是一年
schinese.description: 让单个殖民地到达第365.25周期。

english.name: Slick
english.description: Enter an oil biome for the first time.

schinese.name: 滑入
schinese.description: 首次进入原油生态区。

english.name: Critter Whisperer
english.description: Find and tame one of every critter species in the world. Default morphs only.

schinese.name: 小动物低语者
schinese.description: 发现并驯服世界上每种小动物各一只（仅限默认变种）。

english.name: To Pay the Bills
english.description: Use a Duplicant's Skill Points to buy out an entire branch of the Skill Tree.

schinese.name: 养家糊口
schinese.description: 使用一名复制人的技能点买断技能树的整个分支。

english.name: Honorary Doctorate
english.description: Unlock every item in the Research Tree.

schinese.name: 荣誉博士
schinese.description: 解锁科技树中的每一项。

english.name: It's Not Raw
english.description: Have a Duplicant eat any cooked meal prepared at an Electrical Grill or Gas Range.

schinese.name: 不是生的
schinese.description: 让一名复制人在电烤炉或燃气灶上吃任何熟食。

english.name: Royal Flush
english.description: Replace all the Outhouses and Wash Basins in your colony with Lavatories and Sinks.

schinese.name: 同花大顺
schinese.description: 将殖民地中所有的茅厕和洗手盆替换为马桶和洗手池。

english.name: One Bed One Bath
english.description: Have at least one bed and one toilet for each Duplicant in the colony.

schinese.name: 一床一浴
schinese.description: 为殖民地中的每名复制人至少配备一张床和一个马桶。

english.name: Oxygen Not Occluded
english.description: Distribute 1000kg of Oxygen using gas vents.

schinese.name: 氧气不阻
schinese.description: 使用排气口分布1000千克氧气。

english.name: Red Light, Green Light
english.description: Automate a building using sensors or switches from the Automation tab in the Build Menu.

schinese.name: 红灯停，绿灯行
schinese.description: 使用「自动化」类别中的传感器或开关自动化一栋建筑物。

english.name: Art Underground
english.description: Have a Duplicant with the Masterworks skill paint a Masterpiece quality painting.

schinese.name: 地下艺术
schinese.description: 让拥有「大师之作」技能的复制人创作一幅「杰作」品质的画作。

english.name: Ghosts of Gravitas
english.description: Recover a Database entry by inspecting facility ruins.

schinese.name: 重力之影
schinese.description: 检查设施废墟，恢复一条数据库条目。

english.name: Good Egg
english.description: Hatch a new critter morph from an egg.

schinese.name: 好蛋
schinese.description: 从蛋中孵化出一种新的小动物变种。

english.name: They Got Better
english.description: Cure a sick Duplicant of disease.

schinese.name: 他们痊愈了
schinese.description: 治愈一名生病的复制人。

english.name: Tune Up For What?
english.description: Perform 100 Tune Ups on power generators.

schinese.name: 调校为何？
schinese.description: 对发电机执行100次调校。

english.name: Pulling Back The Veil
english.description: Reveal 80% of map by exploring outside the starting biome.

schinese.name: 揭开面纱
schinese.description: 探索起始生态区之外的地图，揭示80%的区域。

english.name: Down the Hatch
english.description: Produce 10 t of refined metal by ranching Smooth Hatches.

schinese.name: 向下入腹
schinese.description: 通过养殖滑鳞哈奇产出10吨精炼金属。

english.name: Immovable Object
english.description: Block a meteor from hitting your base using a Bunker Door.

schinese.name: 不可移动之物
schinese.description: 使用舱门阻挡陨石撞击基地。

english.name: Easy Livin'
english.description: Have Auto Sweepers complete more deliveries to machines than Duplicants over 5 cycles.

schinese.name: 安逸生活
schinese.description: 在5个周期内，让自动清扫器比复制人完成更多的机器送货任务。

english.name: Job Suitability
english.description: For 10 cycles in a row, have every Duplicant in the colony complete at least one chore while wearing an Exosuit.

schinese.name: 工作适配
schinese.description: 连续10个周期，让殖民地中每名复制人至少穿着太空服完成一项杂务。

english.name: First Teleport of Call
english.description: Teleport a Duplicant and defrost a Friend on another world.

schinese.name: 第一次传送
schinese.description: 传送一名复制人并在另一个星球上解冻一位朋友。

english.name: Soft Launch
english.description: Build a launchpad on a world without a teleporter.

schinese.name: 软发射
schinese.description: 在没有传送器的星球上建造一个发射平台。

english.name: Cluster Conquest
english.description: Land dupes or rovers on all worlds in the cluster.

schinese.name: 星团征服
schinese.description: 在星团中的所有星球上降落复制人或漫游者。

english.name: GMO A-OK
english.description: Successfully analyze at least one seed of all mutatable plants.

schinese.name: 转基因成功
schinese.description: 成功分析所有可突变植物的至少一颗种子。

english.name: Mine the Gap
english.description: Mine 1,000,000kg from space POIs.

schinese.name: 开采缝隙
schinese.description: 从太空POI中开采1,000,000千克资源。

english.name: Cosmic Archaeology
english.description: Uncover the past to secure your future by fulfilling the requirements of the Exploration Imperative.

schinese.name: 宇宙考古
schinese.description: 完成「探索令」要求，揭示过去以确保你的未来。

english.name: Radical Trip
english.description: Have radbolts travel a cumulative 10 km.

schinese.name: 激进之旅
schinese.description: 让辐射粒子累计行进10千米。

english.name: Sweeter Than Honey
english.description: Extract Uranium from a Beeta hive without getting stung.

schinese.name: 比蜜还甜
schinese.description: 从蜂巢蜂巢穴中提取铀而不被蜇伤。

english.name: Morale High Ground
english.description: Have all Duplicants in a rocket survive in space for 10 cycles in a row with a morale of 25 or higher.

schinese.name: 士气高地
schinese.description: 让火箭中所有复制人在太空中连续生存10个周期，且士气达到25或更高。

english.name: That's Rad!
english.description: Run a Research Reactor at full capacity for 5 cycles.

schinese.name: 辐射太棒了！
schinese.description: 让研究反应堆满负荷运行5个周期。

english.name: Full Steam Ahead
english.description: Secure your colony's industrial future by fulfilling the Power Imperative.

schinese.name: 全速前进
schinese.description: 完成「电力令」要求，确保殖民地的工业未来。

english.name: Data Driven
english.description: Produce a Data Bank using a Data Miner operating at maximum efficiency.

schinese.name: 数据驱动
schinese.description: 使用运行于最高效率的数据挖掘机产出数据库。

english.name: Most Valuable Bionic
english.description: Install 8 boosters in a single Bionic Duplicant.

schinese.name: 最有价值仿生人
schinese.description: 在单个仿生复制人中安装8个增强器。

english.name: Blast Line of Defense
english.description: Escape extinction by fulfilling the requirements of the Defense Imperative.

schinese.name: 最后的防线
schinese.description: 完成「防御令」要求，逃离灭绝的命运。

english.name: The Lab: Life Found A Way
english.description: Survive 100 cycles after Demolior collides with your colony.

schinese.name: 实验室：生命自有出路
schinese.description: 在Demolior与殖民地碰撞后存活100个周期。

english.name: Better Together
english.description: Recruit the only freediver Duplicant in the universe to your colony.

schinese.name: 一起更好
schinese.description: 招募宇宙中唯一一名自由潜水复制人加入你的殖民地。
